tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang chog bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi bai shra ba ṇa bak+ti rā gi sa pa ri wa rā ya/ sangs rgyas rnam snang sgyu 'phrul las/ /rgyal sras rin chen mang de nyid/ /'gro ba'i phongs sel rnam thos sras/ /de yang rjes chags dpal 'dzin rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa 'di ni sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phros sems can la dgongs nas/ drang srong rnam mang thos dang / klu me dpal btsun gyi sras su sprul nas gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon mdzad cing / bstan pa skyong bar dam bcas so/ /des na rgya gar du stag gzig gi bstan pa gshigs pa'i dus su slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes byang phyogs kyi ri nag po'i rtsar rgyal po bsgrubs te/ mu stegs nyi ma grub pa dang / stag gzig gi rgyal po'i khri mum la sogs pa thams cad gnod sbyin gyis btul lo/ /des bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta la gnang / des rgyal po g.yu sgra snying po la/ des khri srong lde'u btsan la/ des lha bzang skyid dpal/ des rgya nag tu dmag drangs/ cham la phab dus/ rgyal po'i rten gdan drangs te/ bya rgod gshongs kyi gtsug lag khang du sgrub thabs dang sku 'bag gnyis gter du sbas so/ /de gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis rnyed/ des snur nyi ma la gnang / sku 'bag bya rgod gshongs rnying pa na bzhugs pa de snga yan rnam sras ser chen yin par byed pa la/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos mdung dmar can du ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / sku 'bag gi zhal nas mda' thung lnga skyugs pa'i gcig zhwa lu'i rnam sras 'chams sku'i srog shing du bzhugs par mdzad pa yin/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi dge mtshan dang ldan pa 'di'i gtor bsngo bskang ba'i rim pa la bdag bskyed yi dam gang rung gis chog mod khyad par shis pa phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can la sbyar nas yi dam chos srung mchod tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/

sbyor ba ni/ 'di rang gi mgon khang bla ma yi dam 'di'i sku bris 'bur gang rung mchod gtor spyan gzig bcas bkod pas khyab pa yod na des 'thus/ gzhan rgyal po'i pho brang lta bu'i gnas khang dben zhing gtsang bar steng du bla bre/ logs la gos dar rin chen do shal/ ri dwags dang gcan gzan lpags rigs/ sa gzhir gdan nas lta bu'i 'bru brdal ba'am zhal ba ngos 'jam gtsang dag bcas kyi gnas su rnam sras chos skor sa rnying brgyud pa'i bla ma phyag rdor gos sngon can sogs yi dam/ rnam sras rigs chen bco lnga sogs kyi bris 'bur sku gang 'byor/ khyad par 'di'i sku phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten rnams gang 'byor bshams drung stegs bu bang rim can la gos dmar sogs dmar mdangs yod pa'i gzhi bting par/ 'bru sna tshogs/ rin chen sna tshogs/ sman dug rigs ma yin pa sna tshogs bkram pa'i steng / gser dngul shel dkar yol zangs sogs nas mtha' ma rdza sder dang rdo gtsang ma lta bu'i snod las/ shing bse sogs mi rung bas der 'bras nas gro sogs 'bru bzang dkar po'i rjen phyi dang chu gtsang / 'bras nas gro sran/ til dkar te 'bru lnga/ sle tres/ dbang lag kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ shu dag dkar po/ rgya mtsho sbu ba ste sman lnga/ lan tshwa/ bur dkar/ sbrang dkar/ 'o ma/ mar gsar te snying po lnga/ gser dngul byi ru mu tig mu men te rin chen lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar gur gum ga pur dz+wa ti te dri lnga/ sha bzang sogs dang mar bcas kyis 'di'i gtor ma bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba kha shas yod kyang phyag len la zan gru bzhi leb mo'i steng mkhar gru bzhi rgya phibs can dmar po'i steng gru gsum/ rgyan ci mdzes dmar rgyan can mda' dar dmar pos brgyan pa'i g.yon du gru gsum de'i phyed tsam zin pa gcig bcas kyi mthar zas sna bzang dgu phung por spung pa gtor ma de gnyis kyi mdun mchod cha'i g.yon nas 'go bzung ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod snod bzang sogs dmar mdangs can la mchod yon zhabs bsil/

dri chab rnams tsan+dan dmar pos bsgyur zhing / me tog dmar po'i rigs sam/ yang na 'bru kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba/ spos dkar/ gu gul/ tsan+dan dkar po/ du ru ka a ka ru'i spos/ mar me/ 'bri mog sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ zhal zas dmar po rnams bshams/ sgrub po bla med rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi bsnyen song zhing / 'di'i chos skor thob pa/ gos rgyan stan dmar can drung / stegs kyi khar rdo rje/ dril bu/ 'thor nas dung chos su dril bzang chu 'thor g.yab bcas kyi phyir rang gi g.yon nas 'go brtsams pa'i chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ zhal zas rgyan rang la bstan pa/ dung rnga rol/ spos phor/ spos sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ gnas khang yo byad thams cad la dmigs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bsang ba'i stangs ka tsam mdzad/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bla ma'i gsung rgyun la oṃ 'byung / hūm̐ las bskyed na chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab dang mthun/ oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas so sor snang ba ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

thal mo khong stong snying khar bcas rim gyis bteg dpral bar bskor ba'i mthar s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pa dang mnyam du se gol gtogs/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya/ a warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mchod yon gyi rgya/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gha āḥhūm̐/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ me tog gi rgya snying khar kha gyen du bstan nas/ g.yas pa'i khur tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis chu len tshul byas nas steng nas 'og tu bskor te/ g.yas mdzub mo nas rim gyis gyen du dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ bdug pa'i rgya/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ mar me'i rgya/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ dri'i rgya/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhal zas kyi rgya/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra ma dha ne ta thā ga ta ya arta te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dz+wa badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+re swāhā/ shap+ta nas 'di'i bar rol chen bya zhing / rol mo dkrol ba'i bar la mchod sprin gyi gzungs 'di 'don no/ /de ltar mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs rol mos byin dbab/ khang pa gdan la sogs pa thams cad kyang lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dang yo byad byin gyi brlab bo/ /dkon mchog mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ tshogs pa mang po yod na slob dpon gyis zhwa phud nas/ skyabs 'gro bskul/ rdo rje'i slob ma slob ma rjes 'dzin yin na rdo rje'i slob ma/ rnams kyis thog drangs/ bdag gzhan khams gsum 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan zhes sam bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gi don du yin na rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis thog drangs zhes skabs dang sbyar nas mdzad/

sbyin bdag chen po'i phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ 1 /bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la༞ chos la༞ dge 'dun la༞ 20 sogs ci 'grub/ thal mo snying khar bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ jo bo chen pos sangs rgyas chos dang / zhes sogs phar phyin theg pa gtso bor mdzad pa la/ gsang sngags pa bla ma gtso che bas gong du bla ma zhes sbyar/ de'i dod rkang gnyis re 'phar ba 'di/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos mdzad pa yin lags/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgya/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ thal mo sbyar/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/

/rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /gtum po drag po rdo rje'i sku/ /mi bzad nam mkha'i mdog 'dra ba/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing / /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gyur pa ni thams cad la/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ ni laṃ wa ra nas sa pā ri'i bar pad kor/ oṃ ni laṃ wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs la mchod yon sogs kyi rgya/ swāhā la se gol re byed pa 'gre/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra nai we d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra shap+ta pra ti+āts+tsha swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sang rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ tshogs rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/

sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dag dang bral nas chags sdang med pa'i ngang du sems btang snyoms par bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha nas/ shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swā bhā at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i gzhung du khro bo'i rdo rje rtse sngon po 'byung / sngags 'chang shākya dpal gyi gzigs snang bzhin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun lhad med la gser gyi rdo rje yod pa gnyis ka 'gal ba med lags/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar bas steng phyogs gza'i gdon thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas/ 'og phyogs klu'i gnod pa thams cad 'jig par mdzad pa/ dmar zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma dang / sma ra dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sku stod la dar sngon po'i na bza' dang / sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa'i zin bris na yod/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i khro bo chen po'i skur gyur/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ mchod pa so so'i rgya/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rol mo/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer du 'dres par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ mchod rgya/ nas/ shap+ta rol mo/ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ thal mo sbyar/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bas dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin dag pa sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ phyag rgya sngar bzhin/ oṃ nī laṃ wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rol mo/ hūm̐ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon po/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan/ /zhe sdang can ni 'joms pa'i rtags/ /nyon mongs spong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rdo rje lan gsum gsor ba yis/ /gnod sbyin drag po 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal lo/

/bstod pa rgyas pa rnams mdzad spro na 'dir mdzad/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub bar mdzod/ /rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte ba'i bar yi ge hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i mtha' bskor du/ oṃ nī laṃ wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci 'grub bzlas/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa rgyun par mi mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i skabs sogs su mdzad pa slob dpon rin po che/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i dkyil chog bzhin no/ /gtor 'bul gyi cho ga rnam sras dang lhan du yod pas rnam sras dang 'brel dus zur du mi mdzad/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed do/ dkar po tshe 'phel ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la bdag bskyed 'di nyid do/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta༞ swā bhā wa༞ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gor oṃ badz+ra dang / mjug tu āḥhūm̐ sbyar/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ naiwi d+ye/ shap+ta/ a mṛ ta dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi mdun du bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/

rtse mor nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mda' yab dang / pu shus brgyan pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ shar shel/ lhor baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas phyogs re re nas brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa brtsegs pa bco lngas spras pa/ de'i phyi rol du bum pa bzang po brgyad dang / dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po rin po che'i ljon shing me tog dang bcas pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba bzang po brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa'i phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i dbus ma'i kha brtsegs kyi nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ṇi yig ljang khu/ de'i dbus su tsa las seṅge dkar po rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i steng du nyi zla'i gdan la gri snying bai yig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byas/ dgra gegs thams cad tshar bcad 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus/ gri snying bai dang bcas pa la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku brjid cing 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ sku la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bse khrab dmar po gsol ba/ dbu la dar dmar gyi cod paṇa dang bcas pa'i bse'i rmog zhu gsol ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ spyan rtsa dmar zlum g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa/ phyag g.yas pas mdung dmar dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dar dmar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha lugs can/ mi'u thung khro zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de lta bu'i sku dang phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas khams gsum skye 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i sku can du gyur/

de'i g.yon du las mkhan mdung dmar can bse rmog bse khrab g.yas bse mdung / g.yon shel dkar gyi mchod rten 'dzin pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa'i rtse la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te ri rab kyi byang phyogs lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'jigs byed mdung dmar 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te spyan drangs par gyur/ de'i shar du dzam+bha la ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po bum pa/ nub tu nor bzang dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku bai ra nag po ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po mdung dmar/ nub byang du lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du kun+ḍa li dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa/ 'brog gnas las gzhan thams cad g.yas pa na rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang / mdung dmar 'dzin cing / g.yon pa thams cad kyis ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dmar ba'i mdangs can/ bse khrab gsol ba/ dar dmar po'i cod paṇa bcings pa rin po ches brgyan pa/ rang mdog dang mthun pa'i rta la chibs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du klu chen po brgyad/ sku mdog ser po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba/ thams cad kyis phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na/ rin po che'i bsam 'phel 'dzin pa/ sgrub pa po'i bsam pa sgrub par bsam mo/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du nor rgyun ma/ lhor dbyangs can ma/ nub tu nor skyong ma/ byang du ba ra thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon rnga yab 'dzin pa/ zhi ma zhi khro rus pa'i rgyan can du bsgom/ shar lhor dzam+bha la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag na bse mdung dmar po thogs pa/

lho nub tu rā hu la ra'i mda' gzhu dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ nub byang du bdud 'dul ku bai ra bse'i mdung dar thogs pa/ byang shar du ka la nag po be con 'bar ba thogs pa/ de'i g.yon du dregs pa tre sna ba dan 'dzin pa/ bum sna dregs pa bse mdung 'dzin pa/ sna 'phyar dregs pa rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ sna chen dregs pa mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag shin tu khros pa/ mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /gzhan yang sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad cung zad khro ba phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis sku mdog ljang sngon shin tu khros pa/ phyag gnyis mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /lha ma srin sde brgyad dang / gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs pa/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sprin spung 'thibs pa ltar bsam mo/ /de nas rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i snying kha nas/ 'od zer dmar po'i sna la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas/ byang phyogs nas rgyal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam zhing / spos bsreg lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung / hūm̐ ri rgyal byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang nas/ /seng ge g.yu 'brug rta mchog dang / /rin chen nyi zla sa steng nas/ /rngam brjid stobs ldan rnam thos sras/ /lha klu gnod sbyin gter bdag dang / /stong gsum nor bdag kun gyi gtso/ /srid gsum zas nor rin chen bdag /rgyal chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs rgyal po chen po ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa srung bar mdzad pa khyod/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'bum sder bcas/ /srid pa gsum gyi bdag po ste/

/rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mgon po kun gshegs dam tshig can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /ma dag 'byor pa chung zhing ngan/ /bdag cag nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seṅge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes der dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /shin tu rnam dag dgyes pa'i dpal/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mnyes pa'i tshul gyis myur du byon/ /bcom ldan rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /khyed ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /ye shes spyan gyis thams cad gzigs/ /rdzu 'phrul che bas stong gsum bdag /nor skyong gter bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang lha chen brgyad/ /klu chen brgyad dang gnod sbyin brgyad/ /btsun mo sras dang gshed ma dang / /sde dpon stobs chen 'khor bcas gshegs/ /gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum sde dang / /klu dang khro bo nor lha dang / /gter bdag dbang bdag bye ba'i tshogs/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /seṅge g.yu 'brug rta glang dang / /ma he stag sogs chibs te byon/ /rin chen khri dang pad+ma dang / /nyi zla'i gdan la bzhengs te byon/ /dar zab ber chen mnabs te byon/ /rgyan dang phyag mtshan bsnams te byon/ /'khor bcas pho brang skyed byed byon/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dbang mdzad byon/ /byams gdung srid zhus 'dir byon la/ /mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ces pa'am/ hūm̐ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /sku mdog ye nas dmar gsal la/ /phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan mdung dmar bsnams/

/phyag g.yon ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bskal pa bzang po'i dus tsa na/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang / /da lta rgyal po'i tshul du bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin nor lha pho mo dang / /klu brgyad la sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa dang / oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa ra dzaḥ sa ma ya be shra ma ṇa ye dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas byon par bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sogs gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs ltar la/ bla ma dang rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'jigs byed mdung dmar can 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing sogs nas/ badz+re swāhā bar gong bzhin so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ ma hā rā dza bai shra wa ṇa bhai ra wa shak+ti ra ga sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin rol mo'i bar 'gre/ rnga rol dbyangs sogs dang bcas/ hūm̐ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog dang ldan/ /sa brgyad sems dpa' khyod la bstod/ /gnod sbyin pho mo mang po dang / /klu yi ded dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ /rin chen gser gyi mdog ltar 'tsher/ /rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin la 'dud/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang klu mo dang / /bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sku mdog baiḍūr+ya ltar sngo/ /be con 'dzin pa khyod la 'dud/ /gsang ba'i gnas nas bskul ba na/ /sku ni brjid cing khros pa'i zhal/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan mdung dmar thog /phyag g.yon ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'od zer dmar po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /lha dang lha min dbang du sdud/ /ri rab gling rnams kun gyi bdag /'gro kun dbang sdud rnam thos sras/ /bdag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/

/yang sprul pho nya las la khyed/ /'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing / /ci bsam lhun gyi grub pa yi/ /dngos grub stsol cig rnam thos sras/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /zhes bstod cing 'phrin las bskul/ de nas rang phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs dkar hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer sna lnga zhal nas thon/ mchod pa rnam lnga dang bcas te/ rwa dza'i zhal du thim/ de'i thugs ka'i bai la sngags kyis bskor ba las/ 'od zer lnga byung nas gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub bsdus nas/ rang gi thugs kar thim/ de ltar rgyun du 'khor bar bsam zhing bzlas pa'i rgyal po 'dar/ de nas rang rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bai las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi rā dza'i bai la thim pas/ sngags kyi phreng ba las 'phros/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bai la yang lte ba nas 'thon pas/ bsgrub bya gang yin rang dbang med par bkug nas/ mdun ma'i lte bar zhugs/ zhal nas nus pa mthu stobs dang bcas pa byung zhing / rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad dbang du 'dus par bsam/ /oṃ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya bai shra wa ṇa ye tsit+ta rat+na sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥzhes phreng skor sogs kyi bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin rang la mi zlog cing gzhan gyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i sngags ni/ na mo be shra ma ṇa ye/ ma hā rā dza ya/ tad+ya thā/ ra ra ra ra/ ku no ku no/ khu no khu no/ tu no tu no/ ba sa ya ba/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā be ka ra/ ma hā ka la/ ma hā rā dza rak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa du ma na sarba swāhā/ bar nyer gcig sogs ci nus/ myur du 'grub cing spyan 'dren pa gnad kyi man ngag rtsa sngags nus pa dang ldan pa byed pa'i sngags ni/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye ma hā na ta ya/ a pa ra/ me tre tsan+d+ra shwa ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka swa ta swa ta/ hi ta tsin te/ ma ma ni/ sar ta sam mya sha swa maṃ/ ma hā ka ḍa sha swāhā/ bdun sogs/

spyi sgrub kyi sngags ni/ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa ta/ ku ta ku ta/ pa ra pa ra/ mi dhi ni/ dza dza dz+wa dz+wa dzā ti/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku bai ra ye swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ye ta na ye swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye ma hā rā dza ya/ tad+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsan+dha tsan+dha/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa dha ye/ dharmā naṃ/ nirta an+dhar tu swāhā/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ h+ye hi/ a pa ta dra ti mo tsa ya/ tad+ya thā/ su ra ni su ra ni su ra me/ su su te/ su su ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ rab dngos su/ 'bring sgra dang / 'od dang / dri bzang po dang / rin po che ster ba dang / che btsun dang / zhang blon sogs phyag dang skyes dbul ba 'bru'i char 'bab pa 'byung / tha ma'ang de dag rmi lam du 'byung ngo / /de dag gang rung byung ba dang / snang ba dbang du bsdu ba'i sngags khri yan chad zhag nyer gcig gi bar du sngar bzhin bzlas/ sngags ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye/ snri sarba 'gul 'gul/ ye ye/ dung dung / bsdus bsdus/ dza dza/ zhes so/ /thun 'jog khar gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'jigs byed mdung dmar can 'khor dang bcas pas bstan 'gror dge ba'i 'phrin las thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin sgrub pa dang / khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzod la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas thams cad snang ba mtha' yas kyi go 'phang la 'god nus pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/

zhes me tog gam 'bru dmar gtor/ gtor ma oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā rā dza nas/ sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥbar gong bzhin la/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun sogs kyis gtso bo dang / rta bdag brgyad la rang rang gi snying po dang / klu la nā ga aṣ+ṭa dang / gnod sbyin dang gzhan rnams la/ sarba yak+ṣa saṃ gra ha a ti pa ti la/ bha liṃ ta khā hi/ puts+tsha ho/ zhes pa btags la/ bdun la sogs pas dbul/ de nas mchod pa ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gi gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ mchod yon dbul/ mchod yon dang ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil dang / pā d+yaṃ la sogs pa bcug la zhal zas kyi bar du dbul zhing / bla med rdo rje theg pa'i zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe rat+na zhes sogs kyis rol mo dbul/ gzhan yang / rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang / /bum pa dung dang dpal be'u/ /pad+ma rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ste/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa sogs la aṣ+ṭa la pu dza te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang / /khyim bdag glang po rin chen dang / /rta mchog dmag dpon rin po che/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dbul/ /sap+ta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'am/ spro na rin chen sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga pa'i sngags dang tshigs bcad kyis dbul lo/

/hūm̐ dri med pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhing / /mdung dang lcags kyu sogs 'dzin gnod sbyin bdag /bdag la dbang du sdud pa rgyal po che/ /bdag la dges shing brtse bas bzung du gsol/ /snyigs dus sems can skal ngan dbang gyur pas/ /spang blang sgrub pa'i dam tshig bsrung mtshams las/ /rnal 'byor le lo'i dbang gis 'da' srid na/ /bzod par bzhes shing bu bzhin bskyang du gsol/ /spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig las 'das te/ /yugs mo'i zas dang rta bong sha khrag gi /zas gos snod gtsang zhwa nag gos nag gyon/ /ro la 'ju sogs shin tu 'gyod pas bshags/ /blang bar bya ba gos sngon lung thang phreng / /bse phor rin chen snod dang rta sngon dang / /bya rgod mda' dang mdung dmar spos mchog dang / gri snying bla rdo ma bcangs mthol lo bshags/ /sgrub pa'i dam tshig bsrung mtshams las 'das te/ /bsnyen pa ma thebs gnad la bor ba dang / /dus su mchod gtor ma byas mthol lo bshags/ /tshangs par stsal nas sgrub mchog bskyang du gsol/ /hūm̐ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i gzhal yas der/ /bcom ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /chos skyong phyogs skyong gnod sbyin bdag /nor srung gter bdag klu yi bdag /nor lha sa bcu'i mgon po ste/ /ye shes spyan gyis thams cad gzigs/ /rdzu 'phrul dbang gi stong gsum rgyur/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /gsol zhing rol la bzhes par mdzod/ /khyed kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang / /nor rdzas tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /seṅge g.yu 'brug rta mchog dang / /ma he glang chen dom dred dang / /chu srin stag dang nyi zla'i mdongs/ /skar mda' rlung sogs zhon pa yis/ /khyod kyi thugs dam zhes sogs 'gre/ /rgyal mtshan nor bu'i rkyal pa dang / /bum pa bi dza pu ri dang / /ral gri dgra satwa mda' gzhu dang /

/pu ti lhung bzed mkhar gsil dang / /gri gug lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /thod pa sgrom bu mdung dar gyis/ /khyod kyis thugs dam zhes sogs 'gre/ /bse khrab bse rmog dar 'phru btsan/ /rin chen ske rags pags l+h+wam dang / /rus pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /dar zab ber chen na bza' dang / /baiḍūr+ya dang gser dngul sogs/ /rin chen 'bru dang stag gzig gis/ /khyed kyi༞ /ri rab bang rim rtse bzhi ldan/ /gling bzhi mtsho bzhi gter chen bzhis/ /khyed kyi༞ /shing thog 'bras chen sha dmar sogs/ /'dod yon kun ldan gtor tshogs 'di/ /ri rab rgya mtsho che dang mnyam/ /zas mchog bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i gter/ /dri zhim mdangs gsal sna tshogs rgyan/ /sha lnga sman lnga bdud rtsi'i sman/ /'bru lnga dar sna rin chen lnga/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum gser skyems dang / /shing tog me tog la sogs bcas/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri yang zhim/ /ro mngar reg 'jam ldan pa 'dis/ /khyod kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang / /nor rdzas tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam skong gyur nas/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon 'khor bcas kyis/ /rgyu sbyor mi nor 'khor bcas rnams/ /bsrung skyob sba zhing spel bar mdzod/ /hūm̐ bcom ldan rin chen 'od 'phro yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /'gro don kun la rab dgongs nas/ /yab ni drang srong rnam thos bu/ /yum ni dam pa dpal phreng gi /sras su sku 'khrungs rgyal po ni/ /rnam thos sras zhes mtshan yang grags/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs su/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dbang po mdzad/ /mgon po gar mkhan mchog khyod ni/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba stobs dang ldan/ /brkyang bskum gar stabs skyil krung bzhugs/ /zhi zhing drag po'i tshul dang ldan/ /klu yi bkod pa mtha' yas shing / /rgyan dang cha lugs bsam mi khyab/ /dkar ser dmar ljang sngo skya dang /

/mthing kha mun pa'i mdog rnams ston/ /khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa ni/ /rigs kyi bdag po dag dang mnyam/ /rdzu 'phrul la sogs yon tan kun/ /stobs ldan gzhan gyis mi bzod cing / /gang ba bzang dang nor bu bzang / /yang dag shes dang lnga rtsen dang / /rgyal ba chu mchog kun tu rgyu/ /'brog gnas mched lnga rgyal chen bzhi/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang lha chen brgyad/ /klu chen brgyad dang gnod sbyin brgyad/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /chos spun sum cu rtsa lnga dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /gnod sbyin dbu gtso bco brgyad dang / /gnod sbyin klu ring mkha' 'gror bcas/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /gzhan yang stong gsum 'jig rten du/ /rin chen gter nor bang mdzod 'bru/ /dgos 'dod kun sred lo tog skyes/ /myur mgyogs stobs ldan longs spyod dag /sde brgyad kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /srid zhu byams dang snying rje che/ /yid 'phrog dbang gi las mdzad pa/ /kun gyi gtso bo rnam thos sras/ /'khor g.yog mngag gzhug pho nyar bcas/ /sde dang dpung bcas thams cad la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /hūm̐ ri rgyal lhun po'i phyang phyogs na/ /chos skyong rgyal po ngal gsos po/ /sa bdag dbang phyug gter gyi bdag /in+d+ra nī li'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /'gro ba kun la rjes dgongs shing / /gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs kyi/ /mi zad rin chen gter mdzod la/ /mnga' mdzad thugs rje can la bstod/ /gnod spyin nor lha mang po dang / /klu yi ded dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gser mdog rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /rin chen nor bu 'dzin la bstod/ /mkha' 'gro klu mo bdud mo sogs/ /dbang byed sde dpon mdzad pa na/ /baiḍūr+ya ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /ma rung zil gnon khyod la bstod/ /byams dang thugs rje nyer dgongs nas/ /dga' chen gsang ba'i skur ston pa/

/dbang mdzad pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /dgyes mdzad kun mnyam khyod la bstod/ /rin chen seṅge pad zla'i gdan/ /rjes chags 'phro 'du dmar po yis/ /brjid pa'i sku la bse khrab gsol/ /yid bzhin nor bu klubs la bstod/ /le brgan dar gyi cod paṇa bcings/ /brjid pa stag gi rgyal mtshan dang / /snyan grags dbang sdud mdung dar g.yas/ /khams gsum dbang mdzad khyed la bstod/ /ne'u les dgos 'dod char 'bebs shing / /'gug mdzad lcags kyu g.yon na bsnams/ /'od zer dmar po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /chags shing 'gugs mdzad khyed la bstod/ /rin chen gter dang longs spyod bdag /gling bzhi gling phran la dbang bsgyur/ /lha klu mi dang mi ma yin/ /khams gsum sems can dbang byed pa/ /khyed la gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /gtor ma mchod bstod 'di bzhes la/ /yang sprul pho nya las la byed/ /bdag gi bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs/ /deng nas ji srid sangs rgyas bar/ /thugs kyis mi gtong rjes 'dzin cing / /'gro kun dbang du bsdu ba dang / /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bdag dang yon bdag thams cad kyi/ /lo tog 'bras smin zas gos dang / /khyu mchog rta dang ma he sogs/ /rkang 'gros nor rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /rigs brgyud 'khor 'dab rgyas pa dang / /bkres skom mu ge bzlog pa dang / /yams nad sdug bsngal bsal ba dang / /dgra bgegs tshar bcad zhi bar mdzod/ /srid zhi'i phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /de 'dzin skyong ba'i gang zag rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis phyug zhabs brtan mdzod/ /ces pa dang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ dpal gyi dpal chen srid gsum dpal gyur pa/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug tshig gnyis ma tshang lha gcig po/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnam thos bu yi bu/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /hūm̐ sngon tshe rig 'dzin drang srong khros pa las/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes nas/

/smon lam dbang gis nor gnas rgyal chen gyis/ /dmag dpon dpa' bor gyur la bdag bstod do/ /rin chen dpag med lhun po'i gtsug rgyan ni/ /ngo mtshar zur bzhi rim gsum khang brtsegs dgu/ /sna tshogs gter mang gis phyug gzhal yas su/ /yum sras 'khor mang mchog gis bskor la 'dud/ /gzhon nu lha dbang brgyad kyi cha byad can/ /rnam dag rin chen bse khrab bse l+h+wam dang / /bse rmog mdzes rnams khrag chen gyis sbags pa'i/ /bse mdung 'bar ba 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhab lhub lha rdzas na bzas rab brjid cing / /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kyis spud g.yo ba yis/ /ru mtshon mi bzad dpung mgo lhag ge ba/ /mthong bas rab brjid khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bcu'i lha dbang lha tshogs kyis btud cing / /ma rung tshar gcod 'phrin las bka' bsgos mdzad/ /gzhan gyis mi thub g.yul ngo kun las rgyal/ /dmag dpon rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs nga ro mi zad phyogs bcur yang / /rol ba'i stobs 'gyed gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa/ /bstan la bag med sdang bar bzhugs rnams kyi/ /bdud dpung brlag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje khros pas dgra bgegs 'bum phrag gi /srog 'phrog mche ba zla tshes rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan zlum dmar zlog ljags kyi glog 'gyur zhing / /gsang sngags 'brug sgra sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs ldan dgyes pa'i gar stabs can/ /sred bral dregs pas rab myur drag shul 'chang / /ye shes mi dpung 'bar ba'i gdan sdig gi /nag dpung rtsad nas srog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin bkas rin chen mang bskul zhing / /de yis mi bsrun 'dul phyir khyod bskul te/ /khyod 'bangs gnod sbyin rdul snyed mkha' dkrigs pa/ /dgra snying cig car 'byon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mchod cing bcud gsol bgyis la'ang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub kun ster cing / /sgrub po ma lus bu bzhin rjes skyong ba'i/

/chos skyong rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin dpa' bo kun gyi rje/ /'jigs byed mdung dmar 'dzin pa cha tsam zhig /'dir bstod dge ba gnam lcags 'bar ba'i lce/ /zhes sogs kyi sgo nas bstod nas/ 'phrin las bskul ba ni/ ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs na/ /rin chen dam pa'i pho brang na/ /gnod sbyin dbang po lus ngan po/ /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / /bse rmog bse khrab bse l+h+wam gsol/ /'jigs bral legs ldan dgra la chibs/ /spyan gtum mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /le brgan dar gyi cod paṇa 'phur/ /phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan dngos grub stsol/ /dam nyams snying 'byin bse mdung bsnams/ /phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa dang / /dbang sdud lcags kyu 'bar ba 'dzin/ /'khor bcas thugs dam dus la babs/ /'phrin las ma lus sgrub byed pa'i/ /sras mchog bzhi dang gshed ma bzhi/ /sras kyi thu bo dzam+bha la/ /bdud kyi rgyal por sku sprul nas/ /sku la bse khrab zhol chen gsol/ /phyag na bse yi mdung dmar thogs/ /dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po drongs/ /sde brgyad gtso bo rā hu la/ /'jig rten 'jigs mdzad mche ba can/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol/ /bdud 'dul gnod sbyin ku bai ra/ /mdog nag ber chen sprin ltar gtibs/ /lag na bse mdung dmar po 'dzin/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol/ /dus mtshan nag mo srog gi gshed/ /khro gtum shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /be con 'bar ba phyag na bsnams/ /dgra bgegs khug drongs snying la rol/ /dregs pa dred sna ba dan 'phyar/ /bum sna dregs pa mdung dmar thogs/ /sna 'phyang dregs pa rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sna chen dregs pa dar mdung bsnams/ /ma ra ya dza srog gi gshed/ /myos byed 'bar ba 'jig pa'i sku/ /ma rung rtse ni khro zhing rngam/ /ral pa tshar dgu dgra snying 'byin/ /sku mdog dmar nag thun khrag dang /

/mtshon cha 'bar ba phyag na bsnams/ /gshed ma chen po khyod bzhi yang / /las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas kyis/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo dang / /'khor la gnod pa'i 'byung po dang / /bla ma'i sku dgra sems can 'tshe/ /bstan pa bshig dang dkon mchog smod/ /mdor na log par zhugs pa rnams/ /zung shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ /khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus/ /sod cig skrod cig rings par gyis/ /chod cig non cig khug par gyis/ /thul cig choms shig rnam par shig /rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di sgrubs/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad dang / /byur dang skal ba ngan pa sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /gsang ba'i yum chen mched bzhi dang / /lha dang lha min klu dbang dang / /mi dang mi mthun 'byung po'i tshogs/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor bdag klu chen brgyad rnams kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rnams/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul cher ldan pa'i/ /gnod sbyin ded dpon 'khor bcas kyi/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /'gro la phan bde ma lus bskyed pa'i rgyu/ sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su g.yon dril bu gsil zhing / g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas me tog 'thor/ /thub bstan skyon med yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin gang zag mchog rnams chos 'phel zhing / /chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang / /chos dbyings rnam dag bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /bdag gi 'phrin las bcol ba 'grub par mdzod/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dbang gi rgyal po ltar/

/zhes sogs bkra shis rgyas pa brjod/ bai3/ gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rgyal po chen po nas/ stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ bar gong bzhin me tog dmar po'am/ 'bru dmar rten la gtor/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad sku'i rten rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ nor lha sgo bsdam bya ba yin pas rnam pa kun tu gtor ma phyir 'bul ba dang gshegs gsol mi bya gsungs/ rten rnams la me tog gtor/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yi dam chos skyong 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis bya'o/ /'di ni cung rgyas pa'i lugs yin/ bsdu na/ gtor ma gru gsum che chung gnyis zas snas bskor/ chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga bshams/ dkon mchog la skyabs sems can don/ /'jigs byed mdung dmar can mnyes bya/ /bdag nyid gsang bdag gos sngon mdun/ /pad nyi seng khrir rgyal chen dmar/ /g.yas na stag rgyal mdung dmar 'dzin/ /g.yon na lcags kyu ne'u le bsnams/ /bse rmog bse khrab 'od dmar can/ /khro chags brjid 'gying tshul du bzhugs/ /g.yon du las mkhan rang 'dra ba/ /mdung dmar shel gyi mchod rten 'dzin/ /bka' 'khor bsam yas mngon sum ltar/ /dam ye dbyer med bzhugs par gyur/ /bai3/ gsol lo mchod do rgyal po che/ /mdung dmar can gyi thugs bskyed ltar/ /mchod gtor lha rdzas rang bzhin du/ /byin brlabs nyid kyi thugs rjes bzhes/ /nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags/

/sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun mdzod/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /rgyal dang de sras thugs smon kun/ /bdag nyid myur 'grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /dge des rjes chags dpa' bo che/ /gsung gi rdo rjer bdag gyur cig /ces so/ /ces glo bo smon thang rgyal khab chen po'i ma hā rā dza a haṃ wa shaṃ dza ya badz+ra sa ba sras kyi thugs dam rten du mdung dmar phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i 'bur sku gzungs rab gnas can phul dus sa skya pa kun blos a haṃ yab chen nyid kyi bzhed skong du bkod pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 21
